body:
Companies should not be allowed to offer internships that pay nothing to the young people who do them.

Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Employers should be free to set a dress code for their staff, even when the clothes people wear have no effect on the quality of their work.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that most work is better done by small teams, because colleagues share ideas and catch each other's mistakes. Others believe that individuals produce better results when they are left alone to concentrate on their own tasks.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many new office buildings are designed as open-plan spaces, with no walls or private rooms between the desks.

Do the advantages of open-plan offices outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

In many towns, independent traders are closing their shops because the rent and local business rates on their premises have risen far faster than their takings, while large chains can absorb these costs.

What problems does this cause for local communities?

What measures could local councils take to help small businesses afford their premises?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many adults struggle to manage their household budgets, pay bills on time and plan for emergencies, although these skills are rarely taught in schools.

Why do so many adults struggle with money management?

What can be done to improve adults' financial skills?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many family businesses that have operated successfully for decades fail when ownership passes from the founder to the next generation.

Why do so many family firms struggle when control passes to their children?

What measures could owners take to prepare the next generation to run the business successfully?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that companies should publish the salary of every employee, so that workers can see whether they are paid fairly. Others believe that pay is a private matter, and that open salary lists would cause resentment between colleagues.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people believe that employees should be rewarded for staying with the same company for many years, through loyalty bonuses and long-service awards. Others argue that these schemes keep workers in jobs where they are no longer challenged or valued.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

While some argue that employers should monitor staff emails and internet use to protect company information, others say that such monitoring is an invasion of privacy that damages trust at work.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Companies have a duty to look after the communities and environments in which they operate, even when this reduces their profits.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Young adults should be able to buy goods on credit, since this helps them build a credit history, but lenders ought to be required to check that they can really afford the repayments.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many people now start a small business from home with modest savings, hoping to be their own boss rather than work for an established company.

Do the advantages of starting one's own business outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many graduates spend their first few years after university working in another country, hoping that the experience will improve their careers later.

To what extent do the advantages of working abroad early in a career outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

In many countries, customers are expected to leave a tip for restaurant and hotel staff, even when the service they received has been poor.

Why do so many customers feel obliged to leave a tip?

Should tipping be made optional, or should it be abolished altogether?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

The chief executives of large companies are paid many times more than the average employee, and the gap has widened steadily over the past three decades.

Why are company directors paid so much more than their staff?

Should governments set a limit on the pay that directors of large companies can receive?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Parents who leave a large inheritance to their children give them an unfair advantage, because the money allows them to buy homes and start businesses without having to earn it.

Why do some families pass large sums of money to the next generation?

Is it fair that inherited wealth is taxed differently from income earned through work?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
